_comment: A normal player-facing start for The Missing Guard. The quest keeps its own stage prose for the Captain, Kaelan, and the final return; this graph provides the offer and a truthful in-progress prompt.

greeting.text: Guard Captain Elara studies a river map marked with more pins than she would like.

choices.text: I heard one of your guards is missing. I can help search.
What should I do about the missing guard?
Has there been word of the missing guard?
I will leave you to it.

briefing.text: One of my recruits vanished while checking the river road. Start at the abandoned mill beyond Riverside Docks; it is the last place anyone saw them. Bring me anything you find before you go chasing rumors downstream.

choices.text: I will search the old mill.

in_progress.text: Follow the evidence, not the loudest rumor. The journal has the next person or place that needs you; bring the tabard to me before taking it elsewhere.

resolved.text: Riverside remembers the people who go downriver when everyone else is looking away. You did right by my guard.

choices.text: I am glad I could help.
